cause: Training/serving skew on f5 due to a missing log transform in the serving path. Features f1-f4 match exactly between the two paths (zero difference on all 200 shared entities). For f5, the training values equal ln(1 + serving_value) exactly: max|train.f5 - ln(1+serve.f5)| = 6e-7 and equivalently max|serve.f5 - (exp(train.f5)-1)| = 1.7e-5, both at floating-point precision. So the training pipeline computes f5 = log1p(x) (a log/log1p feature transform), while the online serving pipeline serves the raw untransformed x. The model therefore receives values on an exponential scale at inference time (serve mean ~10.1, max ~47.6) versus the log scale it was trained on (train mean ~2.2, max ~3.9).
